350: Reading: the 0 K formation energies and volumes agree almost everywhere except for GRACE-FS (differences ≤ 20 meV/atom), so the differences between the phase diagrams come not from the 0 K energies but from the vibrations of the solid phases (03A) and the liquid phase (03B). MLIPs with soft fcc phonons (GRACE-FS, SevenNet-0, NequIP-OAM-S: vibrational entropy 1.1–1.6 k_B larger than ACE) overstabilise the solid and push the Al melting point up. The eutectic and solubility limit closest to experiment are those of SevenNet-MF-ompa (850–860 K, 0.132), but its Al melting point is 60 K too high. The system-specific ACE and GRACE-1L/2L put the eutectic 100–150 K too low. No MLIP matches experiment in every item.

MACE-MPA-0 and the GRACE-OAM versions are from the current table (43 / 53 models shown); the two SevenNet entries are the values from the official SevenNet documentation. 390: κ_SRME (phonons) corresponds to the phase-diagram results. SevenNet-0, with the worst κ_SRME (0.767, MPtrj only), has a vibrational entropy of fcc Al 1.1 k_B larger than ACE, so the solid becomes overstabilised and Al does not melt up to 1100 K. SevenNet-MF-ompa, with a good κ_SRME (0.317), has the eutectic temperature and solubility limit closest to experiment.
391: F1 (0 K stability) explains almost nothing of the quality of the phase diagram. The 0 K formation energies agree for 10 models, all except GRACE-FS (differences ≤ 20 meV/atom). What separated the phase diagrams were the vibrations of the solid phases (stage 03A) and the liquid phase (stage 03B), neither of which F1 measures.
392: But κ_SRME alone does not decide it either. MACE-MPA-0, with a medium κ_SRME (0.412), still has an Al melting point 105 K too high, and SevenNet-MF-ompa 60 K too high. The melting point depends on the free energy of the liquid phase, and Matbench Discovery has no metric that evaluates the liquid. Before using a foundation model for a phase diagram, at least the melting points of the pure elements must be checked beforehand (solid-liquid TI or two-phase coexistence MD).

GRACE-1L 2.9x, GRACE-2L 10x, MACE-MPA-0 573 min (60x) with pair_style mace and 76 min (8x) in the production run switched to ML-IAP + cuEquivariance (pk 8481, 11-05).

426: Comparison with the ORCHID literature data (2026-11-03)
427: ORCHID v2026.10 ([Arroyave2026], papers/2610.41164v1.pdf) is a database distributed under CC BY 4.0 of 73,542 pieces of thermodynamic evidence extracted from 1,321 papers (invariant-reaction temperatures, formation enthalpies, activities, etc.; classified as experiment / model / DFT / assessment and flagged for extraction acceptance) together with interior points of phase regions read from Okamoto's assessed phase diagrams; it is not a method for computing free energies. [Arroyave2026] itself compares the 0 K formation enthalpies of 8 foundation MLIPs with the literature values (robust σ 8.6–9.7 kJ/mol-atom, indistinguishable from the 8.8 of the Materials Project) and tries Cu–Zr with PhaseForge, which builds a CALPHAD description from 0 K energies, SQS and short liquid MD without vibrational free energy or TI (single-shot phase recall 0.35–0.56, SGTE 0.72). This is consistent with the reading in section 4, "the differences between foundation MLIPs show up not at 0 K but in the vibrations and the liquid".
